أتخاذل (form VI)
# أَتَخَاذَلُ (ʔataḵāḏalu) /ʔa.ta.xaː.ða.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَخَاذَلَ (taḵāḏala)
# أَتَخَاذَلَ (ʔataḵāḏala) /ʔa.ta.xaː.ða.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَخَاذَلَ (taḵāḏala)
# أَتَخَاذَلْ (ʔataḵāḏal) /ʔa.ta.xaː.ðal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَخَاذَلَ (taḵāḏala)
